scope: Complete teacher-forced native-tool target tokens; supplied preceding answer tokens, not autoregressive patch generation

category_policy.file_family: Path-extension heuristic; tests/benchmark and documentation paths take precedence. Metal means .metal/.metal.h source, including comments and literals.
category_policy.line_role: added/removed/context/header from validated unified hunk counts
category_policy.content_kind: blank or conservative line-prefix comment heuristic; code_or_other is not proof of executable code
category_policy.mixed_tokens: Tokens crossing category boundaries remain mixed_boundary; never arbitrarily assigned to Metal
category_policy.tool: Native serialization/heredoc syntax and EOS reported separately
category_policy.provenance_scope: Checks raw/prepared tokenizer alignment and paired receipt consistency; does not independently authenticate checkpoint payloads, source correctness, or benchmark performance

publication_excerpt.omitted: Per-token arrays in rows[].tokens; all aggregate/per-row metrics and original identity/qualification fields retained. Full source evidence remains in experiment artifacts.
